arxiv-1905-12070.title: Extreme sensitivity and climate tipping points
arxiv-1905-12070.creator: Peter Ashwin, A. S. von der Heydt
arxiv-1905-12070.description: Abstract A climate state close to a tipping point will have a degenerate linear response to perturbations, which can be associated with extreme values of the equilibrium climate sensitivity (ECS). In this paper we contrast linearized (‘instantaneous’) with fully nonlinear geometric (‘two-point’) notions of ECS, in both presence and absence of tipping points.

arxiv-2012-07326.title: Entropy inequality and energy dissipation of inertial Qian-Sheng model for nematic liquid crystals Thanks: August 8, 2026
arxiv-2012-07326.creator: Ning Jiang, Yi-Long Luo, Yangjun Ma, Shaojun Tang
arxiv-2012-07326.description: Abstract . For the inertial Qian-Sheng model of nematic liquid crystals in the Q Q -tensor framework, we illustrate the roles played by the entropy inequality and energy dissipation in the well-posedness of smooth solutions when we employ energy method.

arxiv-2106-04336.title: Efficient Online Learning for Dynamic k-Clustering
arxiv-2106-04336.creator: Dimitris Fotakis, Georgios Piliouras, Stratis Skoulakis
arxiv-2106-04336.description: Abstract We study dynamic clustering problems from the perspective of online learning. We consider an online learning problem, called Dynamic k k -Clustering , in which k k centers are maintained in a metric space over time (centers may change positions) such as a dynamically changing set of r r clients is served in the best possible way.

arxiv-2207-02277.title: Hierarchies of Minion Tests for PCSPs through Tensors Thanks: An extended abstract of this work appeared in the Proceedings of the 2023 ACM-SIAM Symposium on Discrete Algorithms (SODA’23) [ 45 ] . The research leading to these results has received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) und
arxiv-2207-02277.creator: Lorenzo Ciardo, Stanislav Živný
arxiv-2207-02277.description: Abstract We provide a unified framework to study hierarchies of relaxations for Constraint Satisfaction Problems and their Promise variant. The idea is to split the description of a hierarchy into an algebraic part, depending on a minion capturing the “base level”, and a geometric part – which we call tensorisation – inspired by multilinear algebra.

arxiv-2410-04897.title: Complexity results for a cops and robber game on directed graphs
arxiv-2410-04897.creator: Walid Ben-Ameur, Alessandro Maddaloni
arxiv-2410-04897.description: Abstract We investigate a cops and robber game on directed graphs, where the robber moves along the arcs of the graph, while the cops can select any position at each time step. Our main focus is on the cop number: the minimum number of cops required to guarantee the capture of the robber.

arxiv-2507-08034.title: Integrating External Tools with Large Language Models (LLM) to Improve Accuracy
arxiv-2507-08034.creator: Nripesh Niketan nripesh14@gmail.com, Hadj Batatia h.batatia@hw.ac.uk
arxiv-2507-08034.description: Abstract This paper deals with improving querying large language models (LLMs). It is well-known that without relevant contextual information, LLMs can provide poor quality responses or tend to hallucinate. Several initiatives have proposed integrating LLMs with external tools to provide them with up-to-date data to improve accuracy.

arxiv-2508-16391.creator: Abhrojyoti Sen and Jarkko Siltakoski
arxiv-2508-16391.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Abhrojyoti Sen and Jarkko Siltakoski. arxiv-2601-16313.title: Thermally-Activated Epitaxy of NbO
arxiv-2601-16313.creator: Sandra Glotzer, Jeong Rae Kim, Joseph Falson
arxiv-2601-16313.description: Abstract We demonstrate a thermally-activated epitaxy window for the growth of NbO at temperatures exceeding 1000 ∘ C. NbO films grown in this mode display superior structural and transport properties, which are reproducible across a window of oxygen partial pressure. Through comprehensive analysis, we propose the prototypical electrical properties of NbO, for which a consensus has not yet been made.

openalex-w2921196544.creator: Lisbeth C. Bethelmy, José Antonio Corraliza
openalex-w2921196544.description: The wilderness is one of the most widely recognized sources of transcendent emotion. Various recent studies have demonstrated nature's power to induce intense emotions. The study at hand will generate conceptual and operational definitions of sublime emotion toward nature....

pmc-11372716.title: The relationship among body image, psychological distress, and quality of life in young breast cancer patients: a cross-sectional study
pmc-11372716.creator: Hongmei Yao, Meidi Xiong, Yuping Cheng, Qingyuan Zhang, Ying Luo, Xiegang Ding, Chunhua Zhang
pmc-11372716.description: PurposeThe aim of this study is to explore the interrelationships among body image perception, levels of psychological distress, and the quality of life (QOL) experienced by young breast cancer patients.MethodsThis study analyzed data from 339 young female breast cancer patients aged between 18 and 40 years (mean age was 33.47 years) from August 2023 to February 2024.

pmc-11506362.title: Caution for Multidrug Therapy: Significant Baroreflex Afferent Neuroexcitation Coordinated by Multi-Channels/Pumps Under the Threshold Concentration of Yoda1 and Dobutamine Combination
pmc-11506362.creator: Yin-zhi Xu, Zhao-yuan Xu, Hui-xiao Fu, Mao Yue, Jia-qun Li, Chang-peng Cui, Di Wu, Bai-yan Li
pmc-11506362.description: Multi-drug therapies are common in cardiovascular disease intervention; however, io channel/pump coordination has not been tested electrophysiologically. Apparently, inward currents were not elicited by Yoda1/10 nM or Dobutamine/100 nM alone in Ah-type baroreceptor neurons, but were by their combination. To verify this, electroneurography and the whole-cell patch-clamp technique were performed.

pmc-11710491.title: Exploring the factors impacting episodic memory decline in a longitudinal urban cohort
pmc-11710491.creator: Meghana R, Abhishek Mensegere Lingegodwa, Rajitha Narayanasamy, Vindhya Vishwanath, Meenakshi Menon, Divya N Mallikarjun, Amitha C M, Ajith Partha, Albert Stezin, Dev Kumar HS, Prathima Arvind, Sunitha HS, Goutham Velavarajan, Deepashri Agrawal, Jonas S. Sundarakumar, Thomas Gregor Issac
pmc-11710491.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIn the early stages of typical Alzheimer’s disease, there is a well‐documented pattern of memory deficits, especially episodic memory, substantiated with evidence of medial temporal lobe atrophy, specifically of the hippocampus in line with the memory deficits. Studies have shown that several other demographic, biological, and lifestyle factors influence memory and there is a need for identifying early risk factors and for the development of clinical intervention programs to delay or prevent cognitive decline.

pmc-11788483.title: Metabolic consequences of erastin-induced ferroptosis in human ovarian cancer cells: an untargeted metabolomics study
pmc-11788483.creator: Kaylie I. Kirkwood-Donelson, Alan K. Jarmusch, Carl D. Bortner, Bruce Alex Merrick, Birandra K. Sinha
pmc-11788483.description: IntroductionOvarian cancer has been difficult to cure due to acquired or intrinsic resistance and therefore, newer or more effective drugs/approaches are needed for a successful treatment in the clinic. Erastin (ER), a ferroptosis inducer, kills tumor cells by generating and accumulating reactive oxygen species (ROS) within the cell, resulting in an iron-dependent oxidative damage-mediated ferroptotic cell death.

pmc-12602579.title: Notes on the Jellinek-Berry Thermostated Ideal Gas
pmc-12602579.creator: Leo T. Butler, Alireza Sharifi
pmc-12602579.description: This note studies Hamiltonian systems which are thermostated using the Jellinek–Berry thermostat (J. Phys. Chem. 1988; Phys. Rev. A 1988). Jellinek & Jellinek and Berry propose an extension of Nosé’s thermostat (J. Chem. Phys. 1984). They introduce multiple functional parameters in order to achieve ergodicity of the thermostated dynamics.

pmc-13202686.title: Association between the oral microbiome and clinical indicators of resectable non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)
pmc-13202686.creator: Vanessa DeClercq, Rowan E. Murphy, Nick Zinck, Morgan G. I. Langille, Alison Wallace
pmc-13202686.description: BackgroundOral microbial implications for lung cancer outcomes and association with clinical markers are largely unknown.ObjectiveThis work aimed to characterize the oral microbiome in relation to clinical indicators and identify oral microbial biomarkers associated with lung cancer outcomes in patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).DesignThis is an observational prospective study of saliva samples from patients undergoing curative surgery for NSCLC.

pmc-13415019.title: The MDPV Derivative α-PHP Regulates Cellular Differentiation and Triggers Apoptotic Cell Death and Ultrastructural Changes in Murine 3D Neurospheres
pmc-13415019.creator: Fabrizio De Luca, Cinzia Brenna, Marta Bassi, Sabrine Bilel, Adolfo Gregori, Carlo Alessandro Locatelli, Luca Maria Neri, Raffaella Adami, Daniele Bottai, Matteo Marti, Elisa Roda
pmc-13415019.description: Cumulative reports of psychiatric and neurological outcomes due to synthetic cathinones continue to raise public concern. However, the understanding of the neurotoxic mechanism of action is still poorly understood, particularly for the under-explored αPHP, one of the main MDPV derivatives. In particular, the effects of this synthetic drug on neural stem/progenitor cell cultures are still unknown.

pmc-13436081.title: Three-Dimensional Evaluation of Temporomandibular Joint Intraosseous Distances According to Skeletal Class Using Cone Beam Computed Tomography
pmc-13436081.creator: Gissela Maribel Lema-Paguay, Magaly Noemí Jiménez-Romero, Miriam Lima-Illescas, Fabián Darío Bautista Rojas
pmc-13436081.description: ObjectiveTo evaluate the relationship between sagittal temporomandibular joint (TMJ) spaces and skeletal class using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT).Materials and MethodsForty-eight CBCT scans were analyzed and equally distributed among skeletal class (I, II, and III) based on the Beta angle. Anterior (AS), superior (SS), and posterior (PS) joint spaces were measured on standardized sagittal reconstructions using an Instrumentarium OP300 unit.
